title: R2 source-only independent developmental semantic reference, first 44 cases
reviewer: Gemini or explicitly assigned alternative reviewer in a fresh context

baseline.source_queue: original U3-B new 44, projected with native source context; not the C0 previously unblinded 44
baseline.prior_exposure: Gemini has reviewed the method and exposed C1 cases, not authorized to read these new candidate results; do not claim confirmatory blindness.

blocks: R2 reference comparison and semantic method selection
may_parallel: EA-P0 workbench design and access-control preparation

external_sources: Use the four pinned public local standards, no external upload of private source data. Public official documentation may be consulted only if no private labels or data are transmitted; local ID/label/locator must be verified. Evidence not contained in allowed input hashes is narrative support only, not authority for accepted candidate identity.
forbidden_inputs: all non-allowlisted files except this exact configuration and the general protocol
reserved 32-case source-only packet and any reserved 32 outcome
R2 controller_private, execution report, ranked arms, hidden candidates, comparison index, R1/C2/U3-B candidate outputs, prior C1 disagreement or critic results, source code and scores
expert comparison packets or responses, full private raw source datasets, recursive search or other agents results
unapproved external service submission of private source content

tasks: Read only the specified source-only packet and actual source labels, native aliases and reference recipe names. Each case identity must be copied exactly. Reconstruct eight semantic dimensions; distinguish explicit source evidence, inference, external support, unknown. Reference recipe names are not verified measured composition. Do not infer source portions, current food state, species, or nutrient amounts.

Independently search FoodOn 2026-09-20, FDC SR Legacy 2018-04, FNDDS 2015-16. Include up to 3 actually relevant targets per system. For each target use a native ID, exact raw label, evidence locator, direction SOURCE_RELATION_TO_TARGET and conditions. No requirement to find targets. Record search terms and outcome for each of the 3 standards; do not infer absence from failure of a limited search.

Separate EXACT (same conceptual grain only), BROADER_TARGET, NARROWER_TARGET, CONDITIONAL, CLOSE, RELATED, AMBIGUOUS and UNRESOLVED. Conditional relationships need concrete conditions. Missing facts do not constitute explicit contradictions. Do not assign any target an accepted equivalence or nutrient-transfer qualification.

Retain up to 3 actual hard negatives per standard with specific rationale and source/target evidence; distinguish explicit opposition from source ambiguity or target specialization. Record local concept extension as a candidate for future review when useful, not a new approved concept.

Use the exact JSON Schema. Each case retains unresolved reasons, and no-supported-target means no supported target in reviewed material, not proof of nonexistence. Report actual review burden in minutes; no precision or recall without independent adjudicated reference. Finish 44/44 and freeze. No review of reserved 32.

FDC_SR_Legacy.target_locator: runs/B2/U3-A/inputs/FDC_SR_2018.zip!<exact member path of food.csv>:row:<1-based CSV logical record number with header = 1>

FNDDS.target_locator: runs/B2/U3-A/inputs/FNDDS_2015_16.zip!<exact survey_fndds_food.csv member path>:row:<logical record with header=1> | runs/B2/U3-A/inputs/FNDDS_ARS_foods_2015_16.xlsx!Foods and Beverages:row:<actual Excel row>

review_task.evidence_contract: For SOURCE_EXPLICIT evidence artifact_sha256 is the case artifact_sha256, locator is the compact JSON serialization of source_locator with keys sorted, no spaces, UTF-8 unescaped Unicode; quotation/observation comes only from case source fields. For TARGET_EXPLICIT evidence artifact_sha256 is the actual allowed public standard hash; locator equals candidate target_locator. All referenced evidence indices are zero-based. Each candidate/negative must include actual target explicit evidence. Source-only independent references are opinions, not gold.
review_task.model_and_exposure: State actual model/build or UNAVAILABLE. Declare prior exposure; no strict confirmatory blind claim. The earlier Gemini C0, A1 and A2 audit exposure remains relevant.

required.requirements: task_id, model_identity, actual UTC, input_hashes mapping with exact allowed paths plus protocol and task config hashes, actual_accessed_paths, prior_exposure_declared=true, confirmatory_blind_claimed=false, forbidden_access_count=0, real execution method and limitations
44 records, one per source case, exact schema, no omitted unresolved case
Chinese Obsidian Markdown, actual search methods and counts by source/standard/relationship, unresolved and review burden, no claims of independent accuracy or release

task_id, status REVIEW_FROZEN if complete else HOLD, completed_cases, output_file_hashes mapping of other three filenames to SHA256, actual counts, model and exposure, mapping_release_authorized=false, scientific_reference_qualified=false. No self hash.

stop: Freeze and stop. No unblinding, no reserved 32, no code changes or release. If inputs mismatch or cases incomplete record HOLD and actual counts. PI will authorize controller comparison later.
